about_the_game:
Step into the world of Mokitons, mysterious creatures to bond with, fight beside, and evolve. You are a Rookie Trainer with a dream to build your very own Tamer Town in an adventure that captures the pure core of the monster taming genre. Every decision, catch, and battle brings you closer to mastering a fantasy procedural world where no two journeys are ever the same.

Explore the world

Cruise through the world on a scooter with your Mokiton companion. Discover distinct environments like volcanoes or misty plains, each with its own ecosystem. Unique monsters and events await in every region - you must explore specific biomes to target the creatures you want to catch.

Gather your Team and Fight

Every encounter is a test of your tactical mind. The turn-based battle system requires you to anticipate enemy moves while managing your energy and exploiting elemental weaknesses. Plan synergies between your Mokiton to trigger powerful combos and decide exactly when to unleash your team's ultimate abilities. In this world, careful calculation and a true understanding of your team's potential are the keys to victory.

 Everything Starts with the Mokiton

Everything starts with the Mokiton. These mysterious creatures can be tamed, trained, and evolved to fit your specific strategy. Use advanced fusion mechanics to combine their traits and unlock powerful new forms that go beyond standard evolution. Deep customization ensures your team reflects your personal playstyle, giving you full control over how your squad grows and performs in battle.
 

Evolve through Strategy and Fusion

Your journey is defined by the growth of your Mokiton. They gain experience through every battle, reaching new levels and unlocking their hidden potential. As they grow, they evolve into more powerful forms, gaining entirely new appearances and enhanced abilities. Utilize buff stations and Mokiton fusion to upgrade your creatures, allowing you to build a team that reflects your personal strategy. Whether you favor brute force or tactical utility, this deep progression ensures your Mokiton grow exactly how you want them to.

Your story is one of humble beginnings a trainer from nowhere, armed only with courage and curiosity. With each badge earned, each Mokiton caught, and each decision made, you come closer to proving yourself worthy of creating a home for trainers and Mokitons alike.

Will you rise from obscurity and carve your name into legend? The journey awaits.

 

Features:

  • Intense Team Building: Catch, train, and fuse Mokiton to create unique combinations and powerful evolutions.

  • Tactical Turn-Based Depth: Classic combat refined with modern mechanics and energy management.

  • Hybrid Battle System: A unique blend of strategic planning and real-time action elements.

  • Dynamic World Generation: Procedural routes and towns ensure a fresh experience every time you play.

  • Rapid Exploration: Use your scooter to traverse diverse biomes and hunt down specific monster types.

  • Roguelite Challenges: Make critical choices, collect powerful totems, and navigate random events on your quest for glory.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows® 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5-4460 with 3,2 GHz or AMD Ryzen 3 1200 with 3,1 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 670 with 2 GB VRAM or AMD Radeon R9 270X with 2 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 14 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows® 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5-4690K with 3,5 GHz or AMD Ryzen 5 1500X with 3,5 GHz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 with 4 GB VRAM or AMD Radeon R9 290X with 4 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 14 GB available space

short_description: Step into a condensed monster taming adventure. Explore, evolve and battle in a compact monster collector format. Hop on your scooter, build your dream team of Mokiton in a procedurally generated world. Every run delivers a unique map and hybrid action–turn-based combat with roguelite elements.
